paper.title: Revisiting the "Push-T" Robot Manipulation Task with Agentic Robotics
paper.central_claim: A Fable5 coding-agent loop autonomously generates demonstration-free procedural controllers that solve Push-T at100% with46% fewer steps than a200-demo diffusion policy, scale to the full alphabet through self-generated curriculum and port to simulated Franka/UR5 with vision.

evidence.quote: In round v1, a single prompt generated an initial controller achieving a 47.1% success rate. In round v2, autonomous self-refinement overnight elevated the success rate to 73.1%.
evidence.support_explanation: Sequential search trajectory rather than repeated controlled agent runs.
